children.value: > Fact From Story Google argues its commissions aren’t just tied to billing, but rather help it to develop other features and controls to keep Android users safe and guide them to discovering new applications, as well as help fund the tools and services developers need to build and grow their apps.
> > Fact From Story Google will note that 99% of its developers qualify for a commission of 15% or less, based on their revenues.
> > Fact From Story Google also helps developers reach a broader audience beyond the mobile phone, with support for Android across platforms, ranging from tablets to TVs to autos and more.
> > > Fact From Story Google helps developers build and grow their apps. | Fact From Story
> > > Fact From Story Google helps developers reach a broader audience. | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A broader audience can help developers gain more recognition. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge Lower commissions make it easier for developers to earn revenue.
> Commonsense Knowledge Features and controls help users use a product safely.
